owner: the Health and Health Center team
summary: An Al Wakra medical and dental polyclinic appears to lose patients to a free builder address, a 2018 footer and stray page code.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a banner that says This website was built on Wix.
findings.cost: A free builder address looks temporary for a clinic that asks patients to trust it.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clean branded site.

findings.cost: An old year suggests the clinic may not be active.
findings.fix: A footer that updates by itself.

findings.problem: Stray markup characters appear at the top of the page text.
findings.cost: Broken code looks careless on a healthcare site.

findings.problem: A tagline in capitals claims BEST healthcare with no ratings or reviews shown, and no WhatsApp appears.
findings.cost: A claim with no proof is easy to doubt and patients cannot message quickly.
findings.fix: Visible ratings, review quotes and WhatsApp booking.
